Executor notes are self-reported; complete tool transcripts and valid token/full-run elapsed metrics unavailable.
No automatic-trigger test, local Blender render, generated-media comparison, application build/tests or visual browser review.
HTML embedded-data validation establishes content integrity, not browser layout or interaction behavior.
Approval/patch equality and plan adherence do not prove universal directing fidelity, character consistency, speech quality or cost savings.
